42:40: 40. The retribution of a bad deed is a bad deed! But whoever forgives and reconciles, his rewards is with Allah... Indeed, He does not like the wrongdoers.
42:41: 41. And whoever avenges himself after being wronged, for them, there is no blame!
42:42: 42. Blame is upon those who wrong people and cause corruption on the earth without right! There is an intense suffering for them.
42:43: 43. And whoever is patient and forgives, indeed, this is a matter that requires determination.
42:44: 44. Whoever Allah leads astray, there is no friend (Waliyy) for him... On facing their punishment (death), you will see the wrongdoers say, "Is there any way to return (to the life of the biological body)?"
42:45: 45. You will see them being exposed (to the Fire), in awe from humiliation (with their heads bent low) looking covertly from behind... The believers will say, "They are the very losers; they caused loss upon themselves and their close ones during Doomsday! Pay heed! Indeed, the wrongdoers are in an enduring suffering."
42:46: 46. And they will have no guardian friend to help them besides Allah... For whoever Allah leads astray - for him there is no way.
42:47: 47. So, respond to your Rabb before the time comes from Allah for which there is no repelling... At that time, you will have nowhere to seek refuge, nor will your denial (of your deeds) will be of any avail!
42:48: 48. If they turn away (let them), We did not disclose you as their keeper! Your only responsibility is to inform! Indeed, when We make man taste a grace from Us, he rejoices with it... But if the bad consequence of his deeds afflicts him, then indeed, man is very ungrateful!
42:49: 49. The sovereignty of the heavens and the earth is for Allah (who created them with His Names while they were inexistent)! He creates whatever He wills. He grants females to whom He wills and grants males to whom He wills.
42:50: 50. Or He makes them both males and females... And renders whom He wills barren... Indeed, He is the Aleem, the Qadir.
42:51: 51. It is not possible that Allah speaks to a man! Only through revelation, or from behind a veil, or by disclosing a Rasul (angel) to reveal, by His permission, what He wills! Indeed, He is the Aliy, the Hakim.
42:52: 52. Thus We have revealed to you a spirit (the sensing of the meanings of the Names in your consciousness) by Our command... And you did not know what the knowledge of the reality and sunnatullah was, or what faith meant! But We formed it (the spirit) as Nur (knowledge) by which We guide to the reality whom We will among Our servants! And indeed, you guide to the reality (the straight path).
42:53: 53. The path of Allah, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth is for Him alone! Pay heed, all affairs return to Allah!
43:2: 2. By the knowledge that clearly discloses the reality...
43:3: 3. Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Quran, so that you may use your intellect (understand and evaluate it)!
43:4: 4. And indeed, it is in the Mother of Books (the knowledge of Allah) in Our presence, high in dignity (Aliy) and full of wisdom (Hakim).
43:5: 5. Shall We forsake warning you because you are a people who transgress (squander your inherent essential forces)?
43:6: 6. And many Nabis We have disclosed within previous peoples.
43:7: 7. But whenever a Nabi came to them, they mocked what he brought.
43:8: 8. So We destroyed many nations, mightier than them, because of it... The former people became history full of exemplary lessons!
43:9: 9. Indeed, if you were to ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" They would surely say, "The Aziz and Aleem One."
43:10: 10. It is He who made the earth (body) a cradle for you (to grow in) and formed pathways (of thought) upon it that you may be guided to the reality.
43:11: 11. It is He who sent down water (knowledge) from the sky in measured amounts... And with it, We revived a dead land (consciousness)! Thus will you be brought out (from your graves - bodies).
43:12: 12. It is He who created the pairs (double helix DNA) and formed ships (consciousness) and animals (biological body) upon which you ride.
43:13: 13. That you may settle yourselves upon their backs, and when you have settled upon them, remember the favor of your Rabb and say, "Exalted (Subhan) is He who has subjected this to us, otherwise we could not have evaluated it."
43:14: 14. "We will surely reach our Rabb (through continuous transformation)!"
43:15: 15. But they attributed a portion of His servants to Him (denied His Absolute Oneness and assuming Him to be made up of parts, claimed He had a son)... Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful!
43:16: 16. Or has He taken the daughters for Himself, out of His creation, and left the sons for you?
43:17: 17. When one of them is given the news of a daughter, which he attributes to the Rahman, his face becomes dark with grief!
43:18: 18. Or do you attribute the one brought up in ornaments (daughters), who you consider is unable to engage in an argument (to Allah)!
43:19: 19. They defined the servant angels of Allah as females! Were they witnesses to their creation? Their testimony is recorded; they will be questioned!
43:20: 20. They said, "Had Rahman willed, we would not have served them"... They have no knowledge (evidence, certainty) of that... They only talk nonsense based on mere assumptions.
43:21: 21. Or did We give them the knowledge (Book) before this on which they are basing their claims?
43:22: 22. On the contrary, they said, "We found our forefathers upon this religious understanding and we are guided to the reality upon their footsteps (conditionings - genes).
43:23: 23. Thus it is... To whichever people We disclosed a warner before you, its wealthy leaders said, "We found our forefathers upon this religious understanding and we follow their work (conditionings, genes)."
43:24: 24. (The Rasul of Allah) said, "Even if I brought you that which is more correct than what you found your forefathers upon?" They said, "We reject the knowledge with which you have been disclosed!"
43:25: 25. So we took revenge from them... Look at the end of those who denied!
43:26: 26. And (mention) when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what that you idolize..."
43:27: 27. "Except for He who created me (upon a natural disposition - creational program)! Indeed, it is He who will guide me to the reality!"
43:28: 28. He made this word a lasting thought throughout later generations, that perhaps they will turn back to the Truth.
43:29: 29. I made them and their forefathers enjoy of the world until there came to them the Truth and a clear Rasul.
43:30: 30. But when the Truth came to them they said, "This is magic... We do not accept it!"
43:31: 31. They said, "Why was this Quran not sent to one of the great men of these two cities?"
43:32: 32. Do they distribute the grace of your Rabb? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world... We raised some over others (in terms of wealth and rank) so that some may subjugate others... The grace of your Rabb is better than the things they accumulate (of wealth).
43:33: 33. And if it were not that the people would become a community of a single way (through wealth, as wealth exhilarates externalized living and deprives one from inner wealth) surely We would have made, for those who deny that Rahman comprises their essence, houses with silver ceilings and silver staircases upon which to climb...
43:34: 34. And for their house, (silver) doors and couches to rest upon...
43:35: 35. And ornaments of gold! But all that is nothing but the temporary pleasures of the worldly life! And the eternal life to come is for those who are protected in the sight of their Rabb.
43:36: 36. And whoever is blinded (with external things) from the remembrance of Rahman (remembering that his essential reality is composed of the names of Allah and thus from living the requirements of this), We appoint for him a Satan (a delusion; the idea that he is only the physical body and that life should be lived in pursuit of bodily pleasures) and this (belief) will become his (new) identity!
43:37: 37. And indeed, these will avert them from the way (of the reality) while they think they are on the right path!
43:38: 38. When finally he came to Us, he said (to his friend), "I wish there was between you and I the distance between the two easts (an unreachable distance)... How wretched a friend you are!"
43:39: 39. And never will they (feelings of regret, excuses, the desire to compensate) benefit you during this time! For you did wrong! You are partners (consciousness and the spirit-body) in suffering!
43:40: 40. Will you make the deaf hear? Or will you guide the blind and those who are in clear error?
43:41: 41. Even if We were to take you (from the world) We will surely take revenge from them.
43:42: 42. Or We will show you what We have promised them... We have the power to do whatever We will to them!
43:43: 43. So adhere to that which has been revealed to you!
43:44: 44. Indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people! Soon you will be questioned for what you are responsible!
43:45: 45. And ask those We disclosed before you among Our Rasuls (study the knowledge that was given to them)! Have We formed gods to be served besides Rahman?
43:46: 46. Indeed, We disclosed Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his eminent ones, and (Moses) said, "I am the Rasul of the Rabb of the worlds."
43:47: 47. But when he came to them with Our signs, at once they laughed at them!
43:48: 48. Every miracle We showed was greater than the previous one... And We seized them with a suffering that perhaps they will turn to Us.
43:49: 49. They said, "O magician! Pray to your Rabb by virtue of your contract with Him! We will be guided!"
43:50: 50. But when We removed the suffering from them, they broke their word immediately!
43:51: 51. Pharaoh called out among his people, "O my people! Does not the kingdom of Egypt and these rivers flowing beneath me belong to me? Do you still not see?"
43:52: 52. "Or am I not better than this insignificant one who can hardly explain himself?"
43:53: 53. "(If Moses is really as he claims to be) should there not have been placed upon him bracelets of gold or angels accompanying him?"
43:54: 54. (Pharaoh) fooled his people and they obeyed him... Indeed, they were a people corrupt in faith!
43:55: 55. And when they angered Us, We made them live the consequence of their deeds; We drowned them all.
43:56: 56. We made them a precedent and an example for later generations!
43:57: 57. When the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people turned away...
43:58: 58. They said, "Are our gods better or him?" They only presented this to dispute with you! They are a people fond of dispute!
43:59: 59. He was a servant upon whom We bestowed favor and made an example for the Children of Israel that they may take a lesson.
43:60: 60. Had We willed We could have formed angels from you to be the vicegerents on earth (but We made you humans containing angelic properties instead)!
43:61: 61. Indeed, He has the knowledge of the Hour... So, do not be in doubt thereof and follow me! This is the right way!
43:62: 62. Let not Satan prevent you! Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy!
43:63: 63. When Jesus came out with clear proofs, he said, "I have indeed brought wisdom (the Truth about the system and order) to you and (came) to explain some of that over which you differ... So, protect yourselves from Allah (as He will subject you to the consequences of your actions) and follow me."
43:64: 64. "Indeed, Allah, HU, is my Rabb and your Rabb! So serve him! This is the right way!"
43:65: 65. But those who differed in understanding fell into opposition between themselves. Woe to those who wrong themselves from the suffering of a severe time!
43:66: 66. Do they await something other than the Hour (of death - Doomsday) to come suddenly upon them while they are not aware!
43:67: 67. Close friends (of worldly pleasures) at that time will become enemies to one another! Except those who protect themselves!
43:68: 68. "O my servants... There is no fear for you at this time... Nor will you grieve!"
43:69: 69. They believed in Our signs within their being, and became of those who accepted being in submission...
43:70: 70. So enter Paradise, you and your partners (consciousness and spirit-bodies), with joy and pleasure!
43:71: 71. Plates and jugs made of gold will be circulated above them... And therein is whatever they (their consciousness) desire and their eyes take delight in (pleasurable insightful observation of forces)! You will abide therein eternally!
43:72: 72. This is the Paradise that you are made to inherit as a result of your deeds!
43:73: 73. There are many varieties of fruits (gnosis) therein from which you will eat.
43:74: 74. Indeed, the guilty (dualists) will abide eternally in the suffering of Hell.
43:75: 75. Their suffering will not be lightened! They are in despair therein about the future!
43:76: 76. And We did not wrong them... It was they who wronged themselves!
43:77: 77. They will call out, "O Malik (keeper of Hell)! Let your Rabb pass judgment against us (kill us)!"... (Malik) will say, "Indeed, you are of those who will remain (here in this state)!"
43:78: 78. Indeed, We came to you as the Truth! But most of you despised the Truth!
43:79: 79. Or will they decide on what the Truth is! It is We who determine the Truth!
43:80: 80. Or did they think We could not hear what they concealed and whispered? Yes (We hear)! And Our Rasuls with them are recording.
43:81: 81. Say, "If Rahman had a child, I would have been the first to worship him!"
43:82: 82. But the Rabb of the heavens and the earth, the Rabb of the Throne, is beyond their definitions of Him!
43:83: 83. So, let them immerse (in their worlds) and amuse themselves until they meet the promised time!
43:84: 84. It is HU who is (thought to be) the god of the heavens (with His Names) and the god of earth! HU, the Hakim, the Aleem.
43:85: 85. Sublime and blessed is He to whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens, the earth and everything between them! The knowledge of that Hour (of death - Doomsday) is with Him... To Him you will be returned!
43:86: 86. Those to whom they turn besides Him have no (power of) intercession, except those who consciously testify to the Truth!
43:87: 87. Indeed, if you were to ask them who created them they would surely say, "Allah"... So, how are they averted (from the Truth)?
43:88: 88. His word is, "My Rabb, these are people who do not believe!"
43:89: 89. (My Rasul!) Do not pay attention to them, and say, "Salam"! They will know (the reality of the matter) soon!
44:1: 1. Ha (life), Meem (knowledge - the reality of Muhammad);
44:2: 2. The Clear Book (the apparent sunnatullah and the knowledge of the reality).
44:3: 3. We disclosed it during a blessed night (an instance of the experience of non-existence)! We are the warners!
44:4: 4. The wisdom pertaining to all affairs are realized in it (in that state of 'nonexistence');
44:5: 5. By a command from Us! We are the disclosers (of the Rasuls)!
44:6: 6. As grace from the Rabb (of those who are disclosed)! Indeed, He is HU, the Sami, the Aleem.
44:7: 7. The Rabb of the heavens, the earth and everything in between... If you are of those who have attained certainty!
44:8: 8. There is no god, only HU, who gives life and takes life! He is your Rabb and the Rabb of your forefathers!
44:9: 9. But no, they are in doubt, amusing themselves (with the worldly life).
44:10: 10. Watch for the day (the time when the reality of man will become apparent) when the sky will bring a visible smoke (dukhan).
44:11: 11. It will encompass the people! It is a severe suffering (for not having realized and fulfilled the requisites of the reality)!
44:12: 12. "Our Rabb! Take us out of this state of suffering; we are indeed believers (now)!"
44:13: 13. How is it possible for them to be contemplating and taking a lesson now? When a clear Rasul had already come to them...
44:14: 14. But they turned away from him and said, "He is a well instructed madman (possessed)."
44:15: 15. Indeed, We will lighten the suffering a little... (But) you will return to your old state.
44:16: 16. At that time (when the sky brings the visible smoke) We will seize with the greatest seizure... Indeed, We take retribution for all offences!
44:17: 17. Indeed, We had tried the people of Pharaoh before them with difficulties... A karim (noble and generous) Rasul had come to them.
44:18: 18. (Saying), "Deliver the servants of Allah to me... Indeed, I am a trustworthy Rasul..."
44:19: 19. "Do not be arrogant towards Allah (do not defy the Rasul)... I have presented to you a clear and undeniable proof."
44:20: 20. "And I have sought refuge in my Rabb (the Names comprising my essence) and your Rabb (your essence) from your desire to stone me to death."
44:21: 21. "If you do not believe me then at least leave me alone!"
44:22: 22. (Moses) turned to his Rabb, "These are guilty (dualist) people!"
44:23: 23. (His Rabb said), "Set out with My servants in the night (take them away)... Indeed, you will be pursued."
44:24: 24. "Leave the sea in its open state... Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
44:25: 25. They left behind many gardens and springs.
44:26: 26. And many crops and beautiful sites...
44:27: 27. And the many blessings with which they found comfort and pleasure!
44:28: 28. Thus it is... And we left them for another people to inherit.
44:29: 29. And the heaven and the earth did not weep for them (for those who drowned in corporeality) and nor were they looked upon (acknowledged).
44:30: 30. Indeed, We saved the children of Israel from that humiliating suffering...
44:31: 31. From Pharaoh (who symbolizes the ego)! Indeed, he was arrogant and a squanderer (who wasted his inherent essential forces).
44:32: 32. Indeed, We chose them (the children of Israel) over all the worlds (people) with the knowledge!
44:33: 33. And We gave them signs in which there was a clear trial.
44:35: 35. "There is nothing further than the first death; we are not to be resurrected after death!"
44:36: 36. "Then bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful!"
44:37: 37. Are they better or the people of Tubba' (the ruler of Yemen) and those before them? We destroyed them! Indeed, they were guilty (dualists).
44:38: 38. And We did not create the heavens, the earth and everything in between for play...
44:39: 39. We created only as the Truth (the manifestations of Our Names)! But the majority of them do not know (this Truth).
44:40: 40. They will all be gathered at the specified time of differentiation.
44:41: 41. That is time when no friend will avail a friend! Nor will they be helped...
44:42: 42. Except those upon who Allah bestows His grace... Indeed, He is HU, the Aziz, the Rahim.
44:44: 44. Is food for the denier (who denies his essential reality)!
44:45: 45. It is like molten metal; it boils in their bellies.
44:46: 46. Like the boiling of hot water.
44:47: 47. "Seize him and drag him into the midst of Fire..."
44:48: 48. "Then pour the suffering of that boiling water over his head!"
44:49: 49. "Taste it! You considered yourself Aziz and Karim!"
44:50: 50. "This is the thing you doubted (and denied)!"
44:51: 51. Indeed, those who protected themselves are in safety.
44:53: 53. Dressed in fine silk and brocade, facing one another.
44:54: 54. Thus it is... We partnered them (the conscious humans manifesting the forces of the Names) with houris (bodies with superior and clear vision [heart])!
44:55: 55. They will ask therein for every kind of fruit (expressions of gnosis) - safe and secure.
44:56: 56. They will not taste death therein except the first death (they are immortal)! And He will have protected them from the suffering of burning.
44:57: 57. As bounty from your Rabb! This is the great attainment!
44:58: 58. And We eased the Quran in your language, that perhaps they may reflect on it.
44:59: 59. So, observe and wait! Indeed, they too are waiting.
45:2: 2. The disclosure of the knowledge (its detailed explanation) is from Allah, the Aziz, the Hakim!
45:3: 3. There are signs in the heavens and the earth for those who believe.
45:4: 4. And in your creation (humans - consciousness) and the variety of animals (races) are signs for those who have attained certainty.
45:5: 5. In the alternation of night and day, and in Allah disclosing sustenance (knowledge) from the sky with which he gives life to the earth (enables conscious living in the body) after its death (unconscious state - thinking you are only the body), and in His directing of the winds (continuous thoughts and ideas) are signs for people who can use their intellects.
45:6: 6. These are the signs of Allah... We inform you of them in Truth... Which statement will they believe after Allah and His signs?
45:7: 7. Woe to he who lives in denial of his essential reality, deceiving himself with the impulses and instincts coming from his constructed illusory identity.
45:8: 8. He hears the signs of Allah when he is informed of them, yet becomes arrogant as though he has not heard them and persists (in his duality)... Give him the news of an intense suffering.
45:9: 9. When any of Our signs reach him, he mocks them! For them is the humiliating suffering.
45:10: 10. Behind them is Hell! And neither what they earned nor the friends they took besides Allah can avail them from any suffering! There is severe suffering for them.
45:11: 11. This is the guide to the reality! As for those who deny the signs of their Rabb within their being, for them is the worst of sufferings.
45:12: 12. It is Allah who delegated for you (consciousness) the sea (knowledge) so that the ships (brains) may sail upon it by His command (sunnatullah) that you may seek His bounty and be grateful!
45:13: 13. Whatever is in the heavens (levels of consciousness in the brain) and the earth (bodily life) He has delegated all of them to your service (your consciousness)! Indeed, there are (important) signs in this for a people who contemplate.
45:14: 14. Tell the believers to forgive those who do not expect the 'Days of Allah' (when the disclosed knowledge is experienced) so that He (Allah) may recompense them with the consequences of their deeds!
45:15: 15. Whoever does a deed of faith, it is for his own sake! And whoever does a bad deed, it is against his own self! To your Rabb you will be returned in the end!
45:16: 16. Indeed, We gave the knowledge of the reality and sunnatullah, the Wisdom and Nubuwwah to the children of Israel and nourished them with clean sustenance and preferred them over the worlds (humans who are devoid of these).
45:17: 17. We gave them clear proofs (the knowledge of sunnatullah) by Our command... but, after the knowledge had come to them, they fell into diversion out of jealousy (ego) between themselves! Your Rabb will judge between them during Doomsday over what they differed.
45:18: 18. It is with the conditions under Our command that We formed you! So, follow it (the reality, religion) and do not follow the baseless desires (ideas and wants driven by corporeality) of those who do not know!
45:19: 19. Indeed, those (ideas that are not based on the reality) will not give you (your consciousness) any benefit from Allah (His Names comprising your essence)! The wrongdoers are friends of one another! But Allah is the friend (Waliyy) of those who protect themselves!
45:20: 20. This (Quran) is enlightenment (Truths to be grasped by mankind) and a guidance and grace for those who have attained certainty.
45:21: 21. Or did those who earned bad deeds think We would make them equal, in life and death, to those who have believed and fulfilled the requisites of faith? What bad judgment!
45:22: 22. Allah has created the heavens (consciousness) and the earth (the body) in Truth (with His Names), so that each person may live the consequences of what they have earned and they will not be wronged!
45:23: 23. Did you see the one who deified his baseless desires and thus who Allah led astray in line with his knowledge (assumption) and sealed his ability to sense the reality and veiled his vision? So, who can lead him to the reality after (this application of) Allah! Do you still not think and evaluate?
45:24: 24. They said, "Life comprises only the world! Death, life; all of it is here! Only time destroys us!" They have no proof in regards to this! They are only assuming!
45:25: 25. And when Our signs are clearly explained to them, they have nothing to say except, "If you are truthful, then bring back our forefathers."
45:26: 26. Say, "Allah gives you life! Then He will make you experience death! Then He will gather you during Doomsday, of which there is no doubt! But the majority of the people do not know (these Truths)!"
45:27: 27. The sovereignty of the heavens and the earth is (to manifest the qualities denoted by the Names of) for Allah (who created them out of nonexistence for this specific function)! When that Hour comes, those who try to invalidate the reality will be in loss!
45:28: 28. You will see every group of faith on their knees! Every group of faith will be called according to their knowledge. And it will be said, "This is the time to live the consequences of your deeds!"
45:29: 29. This is our knowledge! It speaks to you in Truth... We were recording your deeds! (The universal memory of existence.)
45:30: 30. As for those who believe and fulfill the requisites of their faith, their Rabb will include them into His grace! This is clear success!
45:31: 31. But to those who deny the knowledge of the reality, it will be said, "Were you not informed of My signs? But you were arrogant and became of the guilty ones (dualists)!"
45:32: 32. And when you were told, "The promise of Allah is true and that Hour (when the reality will become apparent) - there is no doubt about it," you said, "We do not know what that Hour is... We think it is only assumption; we are not certain of it!"
45:33: 33. But the bad of their deeds became apparent and the very thing they mocked enveloped them!
45:34: 34. They are told, "Just as you forgot the meeting of this time, We now forget you! Your abode is Fire and there is no one to help you either!"
45:35: 35. "The reason for this is: You did not take the signs of Allah seriously and the pleasures of the world deceived you!"... Today, they will not be removed (from the Fire) and their apologies will not be accepted!
45:36: 36. Hamd belongs to Allah, the Rabb of the heavens, the Rabb of the world, the Rabb of the worlds (He is the One who does Hamd)!
45:37: 37. Majesty (the Absolute 'I') belongs to Him in the heavens and the earth! He is the Aziz, the Hakim.
46:2: 2. The revelation (detailed explanation) of the knowledge is from Allah, the Aziz, the Hakim.
46:3: 3. We only created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in Truth and for a specified time... But those who deny the knowledge of the reality turn away from that of which they are warned.
46:4: 4. Say, "(Consider this) have you seen those to whom you turn besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth? Or do they have a share in the creation of the heavens? If you are truthful, then bring me a remnant of knowledge or a scripture from the past in regards to this."
46:5: 5. And who is more astray than the one who prays to things besides Allah, which cannot respond to him until Doomsday, which are not even aware of their prayer?
46:6: 6. When the people are gathered (those to whom they turned besides Allah) will be enemies to them and they will deny their worship.
46:7: 7. When Our signs were clearly explained to them, those who deny the knowledge of the reality said when the Truth came to them, "Clearly, this is magic."
46:8: 8. Or do they say, "He made it up"? Say, "If I have made it up, you do not possess the power to protect me from Allah... HU knows well that you go to excess in His regard... He is sufficient as Witness between me and you... He is the Ghafur, the Rahim.
46:9: 9. Say, "I am not forming a new thing that has not already manifested among previous Rasuls. I do not know what will manifest through me or you! I do not follow anything other than what is revealed to me! I am only a clear warner!"
46:10: 10. Say, "Did you see (consider) what if (the Quran) is from Allah and you have denied it (what will be your state)! A witness from the children of Israel had testified to something similar and believed, but you were arrogant (about this)! Indeed, Allah does not guide the tribe of the wrongdoers."
46:11: 11. Those who deny the knowledge of the reality said to the believers, "If it was a good thing they could not have surpassed us in attaining it"... Just because they cannot find guidance by it, they say, "This is an old lie."
46:12: 12. Before (the Quran) was the Book (knowledge) of Moses to lead and as grace... This (Quran) is a source of the knowledge, confirming those before it, in the Arabic language, to warn those who have wronged themselves, and as good news to the doers of good.
46:13: 13. Indeed, those why say, "Our Rabb is Allah" and live their lives accordingly will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
46:14: 14. They are the people of Paradise... They will abide therein eternally as the result of their deeds!
46:15: 15. And We advised man to be kind to his parents. His mother has carried him in hardship and given birth to him in difficulty. His gestation and weaning period is thirty months... When he reaches maturity and reaches the age of forty years he says, "My Rabb... Enable me and my parents to be grateful for the blessings You have bestowed upon us from Your favor, and to engage in deeds that will please You... And make righteous my offspring. I have repented to You and indeed I am of the Muslims (those who are aware of their submission)!"
46:16: 16. There are those among the people of Paradise whose good deeds We will validate and whose bad deeds We will overlook... This promise is the reward of Truth!
46:17: 17. But there is one who says to his parents, "Woe to you! Are you threatening me with being brought forth (resurrected), even though so many generations have passed on before me?" While his parents ask Allah for help and say, "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is true"... But he persists and says, "This is nothing but the fables of the past!"
46:18: 18. Those are the ones, of jinn and men, upon whom the suffering of the past generations will also come into effect... Indeed, they were losers.
46:19: 19. All of them have degrees (formed) as a result of what they have done, so they may be fully compensated for their deeds, without any injustice.
46:20: 20. At the time when those who deny the knowledge of the reality are brought to the Fire (it will be said), "You exhausted your pleasures in the worldly life and wasted your life on transitory amusements! So, today you will be requited for being arrogant on the earth without right, and for living with a corrupt faith!"
46:21: 21. And mention the brother of Aad (Hud)... When he, before and after whom many warners had passed on, warned his people in the sand dunes, "Do not worship anything besides Allah... I fear for you the suffering of a mighty time."
46:22: 22. They said, "Did you come to avert us from our gods? Then bring us what you threaten us with, if you are of the truthful!"
46:23: 23. (Hud) said, "Its knowledge is with Allah! I (only) inform you of what has been disclosed to me... But I see that you are ignorant people!"
46:24: 24. And when they saw the enormous cloud (the suffering of which they were warned) approaching their valley, they said, "This cloud brings us rain." No, that is the thing for which you were impatient! It is the wind containing severe suffering.
46:25: 25. (That wind) completely destroys everything by the command of his Rabb! And they became such that nothing remained of them other than their dwellings! Thus We recompense the guilty people for their deeds!
46:26: 26. Indeed, We gave opportunities to them, which We have not given you... We formed ears and eyes for them, and hearts with which they can comprehend the reality... But because they consciously denied the signs of Allah, neither their ears, nor eyes, nor their hearts (the reflectors of the Names to their consciousness - heart neurons) availed them from anything! They were enveloped by the very thing they mocked!
46:27: 27. Indeed, We destroyed the cities surrounding you... We repeatedly explained the signs to them in various ways that perhaps they will turn back!
46:28: 28. Were the gods, which they took besides Allah assuming they would bring them closer, of any help to them? On the contrary (their deities) vanished from them! This (their assumption of god) is a lie and a fabrication of their own making!
46:29: 29. And We directed to you a group of the jinn (beings outside the human visible spectrum), so they may listen to the Quran... When they were ready for it, they said, "Be silent!" And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
46:30: 30. They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a knowledge revealed after Moses confirming what was before it, which guides to the Truth and to a straight path (tariq al-mustaqim; knowledge that leads to the realization of one's servitude to Allah, with or without their consent).
46:31: 31. "O our people, respond to the DAI'ALLAH (the jinn perceived him as the Dai'Allah not the Rasulullah; misused words such as 'messenger' denoting a courier of information derive from this word) and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you some of your sins and protect you from a great suffering..." Note: The jinn recognized the Rasuls as 'DAI'ALLAH,' which literally means the 'inviters of/to Allah.' The commonly used phrase 'Messenger of Allah,' which denotes a postman position to the Rasuls, also arises from this word.
46:32: 32. And whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah (Dai'Allah) cannot render (Allah) helpless on earth! And they will have no friend besides Allah... They are in clear error.
46:33: 33. Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth without failing in their creation, is Qadir to give life to the dead... Yes! Indeed, He is Qadir over all things.
46:34: 34. At that time when those who deny the knowledge of the reality are brought to the Fire it will be said, "So was it not the Truth?" And they will say, "Indeed, by our Rabb, yes!"... "Then taste the suffering now for denying the knowledge of the reality!"
46:35: 35. Be patient, as were those of great determination among the Rasuls, and do not be impatient for them! When they see the thing of which they have been warned (when they taste death) they will be like as though they had not remained (in the world) for more than an hour of a day! This is enough (notification)! Will any be destroyed except those whose faith is corrupt!
47:1: 1. Those who deny the knowledge of the reality and prevent from the way of Allah are those whose deeds are lost!
47:2: 2. Those who believe and fulfill the requisites of faith and who believe in what has been revealed to Muhammad, which is the Truth from their Rabb, (Allah) has covered/concealed their bad deeds from them; He amended their conditions.
47:3: 3. This is because those who deny the knowledge of the reality followed invalid ideas! But those who believed followed the Truth from their Rabb... Thus does Allah give the example (of the two groups) to people.
47:4: 4. When you encounter those who deny the knowledge of the reality (in battle), strike their necks! And when you have overpowered them, secure their bonds (take them as captives). Thereafter, either free them out of favor or ransom them. Until the war is over. Thus it is! Had Allah willed He would surely have made them live (suffer) the consequence of their offences. But he tried some of you with some of them (through war)... As for those who are killed in the way of Allah, their works will never be lost!
47:5: 5. He will guide them to the reality and amend their conditions!
47:6: 6. He will include them into the Paradise that He has made known to them (at the end of the period of battle)!
47:7: 7. O believers! If you help Allah, He will help you; He will keep your feet firm.
47:8: 8. As for those who deny the knowledge of the reality, falling on to their faces in destruction is what they deserve! (Allah) has made their deeds amount to nothing!
47:9: 9. This is because they disliked what Allah disclosed... So, (Allah) made their deeds amount to nothing.
47:10: 10. Did they not observe (travel throughout) the earth and see the end of those who came before them! Let them observe (with their mind's eye and take a lesson). Allah has destroyed them! And something similar awaits these deniers of the reality.
47:11: 11. That is (the truth of the matter)! Allah is the protector over the believers. But those who deny the knowledge of the reality have no protector!
47:12: 12. Indeed, Allah will include those who believe and fulfill the requisites of faith to Paradises underneath which rivers flow... But those who deny the knowledge of the reality will benefit (from the world only in terms of their body) and eat like cattle (animals)! The Fire is where they will abide.
47:13: 13. There were many cities (people) stronger than your city, which drove you out! And We destroyed them (imagine)! And there was no one to help them.
47:14: 14. Are those who are upon a clear proof from their Rabb like those to whom bad deeds have been made attractive (made to be perceived pleasurable) and who follow their baseless desires and amusements?
47:15: 15. The allegoric description (metaphoric representation) of Paradise, promised for those who protect themselves, is as the following: There are rivers of fresh water there that never go stale, and rivers of milk the taste of which never goes bad, and rivers of wine delicious to its drinkers, and rivers of pure honey! There they will have all kinds of fruit and forgiveness (covering) from their Rabb! Can those (who live in this state of bliss) be like those who abide eternally in Hell in a state of burning, and who are given a drink of boiling water that tears their bowels?
47:16: 16. And some of them will (come and) listen to you... And when they leave they will say to those to whom the knowledge has been given, "What did he just say?" (They will not understand!) They are the ones whose hearts Allah has sealed (locked their consciousness) who follow baseless desires and amusements.
47:17: 17. But to those who attain the reality, He expands their ability to experience the reality and enables them to protect themselves (from behaviors that go against or impede the experience of the reality).
47:18: 18. Are they awaiting the Hour (of death) to suddenly come upon them? Its signs have already come! But what can they do when (that Hour) actually comes to them?
47:19: 19. So, know then that there is no god, there is only Allah; and ask forgiveness for your mistakes (inadequacies of your human nature) and the believing men and women (help them to understand the reality so they may be forgiven)! Allah knows of your movement (states) and the place of your eternal abode!
47:20: 20. The believers say, "Why has a surah (chapter) not been disclosed (regarding the rules of battle)?" But when a surah with clear rules is disclosed and battle is mentioned therein, you will see those in whose hearts is sickness (duality, hypocrisy) looking at you like one who has fainted in fear of death! (Whereas) this is better for them!
47:21: 21. (Their duty here is) obedience and a good word! And when the matter is settled, if they had been loyal to Allah, surely it would have been better for them.
47:22: 22. If you turn back, would you not be causing corruption on the earth and severing your ties of relations?
47:23: 23. They are those who Allah has cursed, deafened and whose vision (Allah) blinded.
47:24: 24. Do they not contemplate on the Quran systematically and in depth? Or are there locks (incorrect conditionings) upon their hearts (consciousness)?
47:25: 25. As for those (hypocrites) who turn away after the reality becomes clearly manifest, Satan (corruptive thoughts) has made this pleasing to them and amused them with wishful thinking.
47:26: 26. The reason they are in this state is because they said, to those who were not pleased with what Allah disclosed, "We will follow you in part of the matter"... (Whereas) Allah knows what they conceal.
47:27: 27. And how will it be when the angels take them in death (disconnect them from their bodies), striking their faces and backs?
47:28: 28. It is thus! This is because they followed things that angered Allah; they did not like (the way of) His pleasure, and Allah made their deeds worthless!
47:29: 29. Or did those with ill thoughts think Allah would not expose their (concealed) hatred?
47:30: 30. If We had willed, We could have shown them to you and you would have recognized them from their faces! Indeed, you will know them from the tone of their speech... Allah knows what you do!
47:31: 31. Indeed, We will try you (with afflictions) until the strivers (in the way of Allah) and the patient ones among you become apparent... And We will spread your news!
47:32: 32. Indeed, those who deny the knowledge of the reality, prevent from the way of Allah, and who oppose the Rasul (of Allah) after the knowledge of the reality is explained to them can never cause any harm to Allah! But their deeds will be rendered worthless.
47:33: 33. O believers! Obey Allah and obey the Rasul; do not render your deeds worthless!
47:34: 34. Indeed, those who deny the knowledge of the reality and prevent people from the way of Allah (with physical or spiritual means) and who die with their denial, Allah will never forgive them!
47:35: 35. Do not weaken and call to peace (merge the truth with falsehood) while you are superior! Allah is 'One' with you! He will never lessen your deeds.
47:36: 36. The life of the world is only play and amusement! If you believe and protect yourselves, He will give you your rewards and He will not ask you (to give up) all of your wealth (for this cause)!
47:37: 37. If He had asked you (for all of it) and pressured you, you would have been stingy and (thus) He would have exposed your hatred.
47:38: 38. Here you are, being invited to share unrequitedly in the way of Allah! But among you are some who are stingy! And whoever is stingy, is only stingy towards his own self! Allah is the Ghani; you are the needy! If you turn away, He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you!
48:1: 1. Indeed, we have given you the Clear Conquest (fath; the clear observation of the system of the reality)!
48:2: 2. That Allah may forgive (cover/conceal) your past and (in spite of the conquest - fath) future misdeeds (the veils resulting from corporeality) and complete His favor upon you and guide you to the experience of your reality (essence).
48:3: 3. Allah will lead you to an unmatched mighty victory!
48:4: 4. It is HU who sends tranquility (sense of security) to the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith! The soldiers of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah! Allah is the Aleem, the Hakim.
48:5: 5. And to admit the believing men and women to Paradises, underneath which rivers flow, in which they will abide eternally, in order to remove from them their bad deeds... This is the great attainment in the sight of Allah!
48:6: 6. And that He may punish the hypocrite men and women and the dualist men and women who misperceive Allah who comprises their essential reality with His Names (as a god)! May the evil turn of fortune be upon them for their assumptions! Allah's wrath and curse is upon them (distanced them from the experience of the reality due to their denial) and prepared Hell for them! What a wretched place of return!
48:7: 7. The soldiers (forces) of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah... Allah is the Aziz, the Hakim.
48:8: 8. Indeed, we disclosed you as a witness, giver of good news and as a warner!
48:9: 9. So, believe in Allah - your essential reality with His Names - and His Rasul; support him, exalt and respect him, and engage in glorifying Him (tasbih) by morning and night.
48:10: 10. Indeed, (my Rasul) those who pledge allegiance to you have pledged allegiance to Allah. The hand of Allah is over their hands (the hand of Allah administers over the hands of those who pledge allegiance)! So, he who breaks his word has broken it against his own self, and he who keeps his word to Allah will be given a great reward!
48:11: 11. Those who remained behind of the Bedouins say, "Our properties and children kept us occupied, so ask forgiveness for us"... But they say with their tongues what they do not actually mean! Say, "Who can go against the will of Allah if He intended to give you harm or if He willed to benefit you?"... No, Allah is aware of what you do (as the creator of your actions).
48:12: 12. You thought the Rasul and the believers would not return to their families! This seemed pleasing to your consciousness, and thus you assumed a bad assumption and became a people worthy of suffering!
48:13: 13. Whoever does not believe in Allah and His Rasul, as their essential reality with His Names, let them know that We have prepared a blaze (of fire - waves of radiation) for those who deny the knowledge of the reality.
48:14: 14. The sovereignty of the heavens and the earth is for (the manifestation of the Names of) Allah! He forgives (covers the offensive state of) whom He wills and gives suffering (the consequence of corporeality) to whom He wills! Allah is the Ghafur, the Rahim.
48:15: 15. Those who remained behind will say when you go to collect the spoils of war, "Let us come with you." They want to change the words of Allah. Say, "You can never follow us; for this is what Allah said (decreed) before"... Then they will say, "No, you envy us"... On the contrary, they are people devoid of understanding!
48:16: 16. Say to the Bedouins who remained behind, "You will be called to battle against a people of great strength and might... Either you fight them or they will submit (to Islam). If you obey, Allah will give you a good reward... But if you turn away as you turned away before, then He will subject you to a great suffering."
48:17: 17. There is no obligation upon the blind, the cripple and the one who is ill! If he obeys Allah and His Rasul He will admit him to Paradises underneath which rivers flow... But whoever turns away, He will punish him with a severe suffering.
48:18: 18. Indeed, Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He gave tranquility (serenity) to their hearts and rewarded them with an imminent conquest (certainty).
48:19: 19. And He gave them many spoils of war... Allah is the Aziz, the Hakim.
48:20: 20. Allah has promised many spoils of war to you... And He has hastened this for you and withheld the hands of people from you that this may be a sign for the believers and that He may guide you to a straight path.
48:21: 21. And He promised other things to them, which you are not capable of, that Allah had already encompassed (internally and externally). Allah is Qadir over all things.
48:22: 22. If those who deny the knowledge of the reality were to fight with you they would surely have turned their backs in flight... And then they would not have found a friend (protector) or a helper.
48:23: 23. This is the established sunnatullah! And never will you find in the sunnatullah (the mechanics of Allah's system) any change!
48:24: 24. It is HU who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them in the center of Mecca after He made you overcome them. Allah is Basir of your actions (as their creator).
48:25: 25. They are those who deny the knowledge of the reality, obstruct you from the Masjid al-Haram, and prevent the offerings from reaching their places... If it was not for the believing men and women (among them), of whom you are unaware, and thus could inadvertently trample and then be upset by it (Allah would not have prevented the battle)... This was so that Allah may admit whom He wills to His grace... If the (believers and nonbelievers) had been separate from one another, surely We would have punished those who disbelieved with a severe suffering. (Suffering does not befall a place where there are righteous people... 8:33, 29:32)
48:26: 26. The deniers of the knowledge of the reality had put patriotism (ethnocentricity, pride out of ignorance) and narrow-mindedness (conservatism) into their hearts... Allah gave tranquility (serenity) to those who believed in Allah and His Rasul and secured them upon the Truth: "There is no god, only Allah" (La ilaha illaAllah)... They were those who experienced this reality and were deserving of it... Allah is Aleem of all things.
48:27: 27. Indeed, Allah confirmed to His Rasul his vision in Truth... InshaAllah (with the manifestation of the Names of Allah comprising your essence), you will most definitely enter the Masjid al-Haram, in safety, with (some of) your heads shaved or shortened, without any fear! (Allah) knowing what you do not know, has arranged before this an imminent conquest (of closeness/certainty).
48:28: 28. He disclosed His Rasul as the articulator of the reality and upon the religion of Truth (the understanding of the reality of sunnatullah, which is the system and order manifesting the Names of Allah) superior to all understanding of religion! And sufficient is Allah (with His presence in their being) as Shahid (Witness).
48:29: 29. Muhammad is the Rasul of Allah! Those with him are stern against the deniers of the reality, but compassionate among themselves... You will see them bowing (in awe of the observation of Allah's Names as the absolute administrator over existence at all times), prostrating (with the awareness that existence comprises only the Names and thus experiencing their nonexistence with the realization of not having a separate independent being), seeking the bounty (the awareness of the forces of the Names) and the pleasure of Allah (enlightenment to the reality and the ability to actualize its potentials)... And on their faces (consciousness) is the mark of prostration (the comprehension of their nonexistence)! This is their metaphoric description in the Torah (laws in regards to the identity-self)... And their description (similitude) in the Gospel is that of a plant, which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, giving delight to its sowers... Allah does this to enrage the deniers (coverers) of the reality with them (the manifestations of His Names)! Allah has promised those who believe and fulfill its requisites, forgiveness and a great reward.
49:1: 1. O believers... Do not forge ahead of Allah and His Rasul (with your identity based thoughts, comments and interpretations), and protect yourselves from Allah (for He will subject you to the consequences of your conditioned value judgments)! Indeed, Allah is the Sami, the Aleem.
49:2: 2. O believers... Do not raise your voices (ideas and thoughts) over the voice (the teachings) of the Nabi! Do not address him loudly like the way you (recklessly) address each other! Or your deeds will become worthless without you even realizing!
49:3: 3. Those who lower their voices in the presence of the Rasul of Allah, they are the ones whose level of understanding Allah has revealed... There is forgiveness for them and a great reward.
49:4: 4. As for those who call out to you from (outside) your house, most of them cannot use their intellects! (Note that calling him out is looked upon as an unintellectual act. A noteworthy topic!)
49:5: 5. Had they been patient until you went out to them, it would surely have been better for them. Allah is the Ghafur, the Rahim.
49:6: 6. O believers... If someone with corrupt faith brings information to you, investigate it well... Lest you maltreat a people without knowing the truth of the matter and then become regretful over what you have done!
49:7: 7. Understand well that the Rasul of Allah is within you! If he was to follow you in most affairs, surely you would be distressed! But Allah endeared faith (experiencing your essence) to you and made it pleasing to your perception and made denial (of the reality), defiance (acts that go against faith and which blind one's consciousness) and rebellion (ego-based ambitions) unpleasing to you... Those are the ones who have attained maturity!
49:8: 8. As bounty and favor from Allah... Allah is the Aleem, the Hakim.
49:9: 9. And if two groups among the believers fight against each other, make peace between them... If one goes to excess and oppresses the other, fight the oppressors until they return to the command of Allah! If they return, then make reconciliation between them with justice. Indeed, Allah likes those who give all things their due right.
49:10: 10. Indeed, the believers are brothers! So, make peace between the two brothers and protect yourselves from Allah so that you may attain grace.
49:11: 11. O believers... Let not one group mock the other! They (who they mock) may be better than them! And let not the women (ridicule) the women! Perhaps they (the others) are better than them! And do not criticize one another and do not call each other by offensive names! What a terrible label it is when faith gives way to non-belief. And whoever has not repented, they are the very wrongdoers!
49:12: 12. O you who have believed, avoid most assumptions (guesswork about things of which you have no certain knowledge). Indeed, certain assumptions are an offence (lead to or are an outcome of duality). And do not spy on others (do not inspect or inquire into the private matters of others out of curiosity), and do not backbite. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it! So, protect yourselves from Allah, the Tawwab, the Rahim.
49:13: 13. O people... Indeed, We have (always) created you from a male and a female (no stated exception for Adam here); and made you into races-nations and communities so that you may come to know (and acquire different qualities and virtues from) each other... Indeed, the noblest of you in the sight of Allah are those who are true to themselves (their essential reality)! Indeed, Allah is the Aleem, the Habir.
49:14: 14. The Bedouins (those who lived in ignorance as tribes and clans) said, "We have believed"... Say, "You did not believe! Say 'We have submitted (become Muslims)'! For faith is not yet clarified and established in your consciousness! If you obey Allah and His Rasul, (Allah) will not detract anything from your work... Indeed, Allah is the Ghafur, the Rahim."
49:15: 15. The believers are those who have believed in Allah, who has created their being with His Names, and His Rasul, and did not fall into doubt thereof and fought in the way of Allah with their wealth and their very beings (lives)! They are the truthful ones (who conform the reality with their very lives)!
49:16: 16. Say, "Are you attempting to teach your understanding of religion to Allah! Allah knows what is in the heavens and the earth... Allah is Aleem over all things."
49:17: 17. Do they think they are doing you a favor by becoming Muslims! Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me (it is for your own sake)! On the contrary, it is Allah's favor to you that He has directed you to faith! If you are truthful (to your faith, you will know this is true)."
49:18: 18. Indeed, Allah knows the unperceivable within the heavens and the earth... Allah (within your very being) is Basir over what you do.
50:1: 1. Qaf (The Arabic letter Qaf symbolizes the ego, the first of the three reflections of the absolute essence of man [ego, oneness, identity] In Sufism, Mount Qaf is considered to be the symbol of the ego. Mountains often symbolize the ego), the Magnificent Quran (the disclosure of magnificent Knowledge)!
50:2: 2. Surprised that the warner who came to them was someone from among themselves, the deniers of the knowledge of the reality said, "This is a strange thing, indeed..."
50:3: 3. "Will we (be resurrected) once we have died and become dust? That is a distant return (a far-fetched claim)."
50:4: 4. We know exactly what the earth detracts from them (what is lost with old age)... With us is the Book of Records (the universal memory recorded within the essence of existence).
50:5: 5. No, they denied their essential reality when it came to them! They are in a confused state.
50:6: 6. (Assuming to be the body) did they not look at the sky above them (consciousness) to see how We formed it and adorned it (with senses)! There is no flaw in it!
50:7: 7. We developed the earth (the body) and formed upon it firmly set mountains (organs)! And produced therein from every beautiful pair (double helix DNA) the vegetal properties of the body.
50:8: 8. To activate insight, to remind and give admonition to every servant (who turns to his essence).
50:9: 9. We sent down water (knowledge) from the sky with which We made to grow gardens (the experience of the beauteous inherent forces) and grains that are harvested (various abilities).
50:10: 10. And lofty palm trees with clusters of fruit...
50:11: 11. As sustenance of life for the servants... We gave life with it to a dead land... Thus is the resurrection (coming forth from one's cocoon world).
50:12: 12. And before them, the people of Noah, the people of the well and Thamud also denied (the eternal life to come after death).
50:13: 13. And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brothers of Lot.
50:14: 14. And the people of the wood and the people of Tubba... All of them denied and thus My punishment, of which they were notified, was fulfilled.
50:15: 15. Were We inadequate in the first creation? No, they are in doubt of the new creation.
50:16: 16. Indeed, it is We who created man... We know what his soul whispers to him (the idea of being only the body formed by his mind)... We are closer to him (within the dimensions of the brain) than his jugular vein!"
50:17: 17. Two recording forces record from his right and from his left!
50:18: 18. Every thought (of man) is observed (recorded) by an observer!
50:19: 19. And the intoxication of death has come, revealing the Truth! This is the very thing you tried to escape!
50:20: 20. And the Horn (body) is blown (the act of blowing occurs from the inside out - the spirit has left the body)! This is the time of which you were warned!
50:21: 21. Every soul (consciousness) will come with an attendant (his constructed identity through corporeality) and a witness (the call of his conscience voicing the Truth)!
50:22: 22. (It will be said), "You were certainly unaware of this (you were living in your cocoon), and We have removed from you your veil, so your sight, from this period on, is sharp."
50:23: 23. His companion (body - jinn friend) will say, "Here it is, ready with me."
50:24: 24. (It will be said), "Cast into Hell every persistent ungrateful denier of the reality!"
50:25: 25. "The preventer of every good (pertaining to the Truth) and doubter."
50:26: 26. Who made besides Allah another god! Throw him into severe suffering!"
50:27: 27. His companion (while the word human/man is a reference to consciousness, the word companion denotes one's body or one's jinn friend) said, "My Rabb, it was not me who made him transgress, he himself was in an extreme error."
50:28: 28. (Allah) said, "Do not bicker in my presence (there is no point in arguing in My presence)! I had already warned you about what was to come!"
50:29: 29. "And My judgment shall not be changed! I am not unjust to the servants!"
50:30: 30. At that time We will ask Hell, "Are you now full?"... (Hell will say), "Are there any more?"
50:31: 31. And Paradise will be brought near to the protected ones... It was not far from them anyway.
50:32: 32. "This is what you were promised," it will be said to those who turned to their essence and protected themselves.
50:33: 33. The one who is in awe of the Rahman as his unknown, and who comes in a state of consciousness turned (to his essence).
50:34: 34. Enter therein as salam (experiencing the meaning of the Name Salam)... This is the eternal life!
50:35: 35. They will have whatever they desire therein, and even more with Us!
50:36: 36. Many generations We have destroyed before them who were mightier than them in strength! And they sought a place (of refuge) because of this... Is there any place of escape?
50:37: 37. Undoubtedly this reminder is for the conscious one or the one who listens attentively!
50:38: 38. Indeed, We created the heavens, the earth and everything in between in six stages! And We were not touched by weariness!
50:39: 39. So, be patient about what they say! And glorify (tasbih) your Rabb as His Hamd (fulfill your purpose) before sunrise and sunset!
50:40: 40. And glorify Him in the night and after prostration!
50:41: 41. And listen, in that time, when the Caller will call from within!
50:42: 42. The time when they will hear the blast in Truth! That is the time of emergence (awakening to the reality outside the cocoon)!
50:43: 43. Indeed, it is Us, yes Us, who gives life and takes life! And to Us is the return!
50:44: 44. At that time, the earth (body) will hastily break away from them! That is, for Us, an easy gathering.
50:45: 45. As We are present within them, We know better what they say! You cannot force them into anything! Remind (the reality) by the Quran to those who fear my warning of suffering.
51:1: 1. By the scattering and the dispersing (winds).
51:3: 3. And those who flow with ease.
51:4: 4. And those who apportion the command!
51:5: 5. What you are promised is certainly true!
51:6: 6. Indeed, religion (the system) is an absolute reality!
51:7: 7. The heaven (consciousness) full of pathways (of various thoughts)!
51:8: 8. Indeed, you are in differing views!
51:9: 9. He who is turned away is turned away from it!
51:11: 11. Who are confused in ignorance and blindness!
51:12: 12. "When is the time of religion (recompense)?" they ask.
51:13: 13. They will thrash about in the fire at that time.
51:14: 14. (They will be told by the creatures of Hell), "Taste your suffering! This is what you were impatient for!"
51:15: 15. Indeed, those who protected themselves will be in Paradises and springs.
51:16: 16. As receivers of the blessings of their Rabb (from within). Indeed, before this they were doers of good.
51:17: 17. They would sleep in a small portion of the night.
51:18: 18. And ask for forgiveness before dawn.
51:19: 19. And there was a portion among their properties for the needy and the troubled.
51:20: 20. There are signs on the earth (the body) for those who are certain!
51:21: 21. Within your own selves (the essence of the self). Do you still not see (realize)?
51:22: 22. Both your provision and what you are promised is in heaven (experienced from one's consciousness)!
51:23: 23. By the Rabb of the heaven and the earth, it (what you are informed of in regards to the future) is true - as natural and true as your ability to speak.
51:24: 24. Did you receive the news of Abraham's honored guests?
51:25: 25. When they came to him they said, "Salam"... (And Abraham said), "Salam"... And thought, "Unusual people..."
51:26: 26. Then He turned to his family and brought a (roasted) calf.
51:27: 27. And offered it to them and said, "Will you not eat?"
51:28: 28. (When he saw that they did not eat) he felt apprehensive! "Fear not" they said and gave him the good news of a learned son.
51:29: 29. And his wife cried and returned to the guests, covering her face with her hands, and said, "But I am a barren old woman!"
51:30: 30. (Abraham's guests, the angels) said, "Thus it will be! It is what your Rabb said... Indeed, He is the Hakim, the Aleem."
51:31: 31. (Abraham) said, "O disclosed ones... What is your (real) business (purpose)?"
51:32: 32. They said, "Indeed, we have been disclosed for a guilty people!"
51:33: 33. "That we may send down stones of clay upon them."
51:34: 34. "Marked (stones) in the sight of your Rabb for the transgressors (who waste the forces they are given to attain the reality)!"
51:35: 35. So, We took all the believers out from there.
51:36: 36. Not that we found any, except for a single household of those who have submitted (Muslims)!
51:37: 37. And we left a sign therein for those who fear that severe suffering.
51:38: 38. Like that in Moses... When We had disclosed him as a clear sign to Pharaoh.
51:39: 39. But he turned away with his rulers and said, "A magician or a madman!"
51:40: 40. So, We seized him and his army and cast them into the sea... And he beat himself up in regret!
51:41: 41. And in Aad... How We had disclosed that wind within which there was no good or blessing (cyclone)...
51:42: 42. It left nothing standing of whatever it came upon; disintegrated it into bits!
51:43: 43. And in Thamud... How they were told, "Enjoy yourself for a time."
51:44: 44. But they went against the command of their Rabb! So, a thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
51:45: 45. And they were not able to survive, nor did they receive any help!
51:46: 46. And the people of Noah before them... Indeed, they were a people of corrupt faith!
51:47: 47. As for the heaven (the universe and the capacity of the brain), it is We who built it and We who expands it (via dimensional formations - beings - the expansion of the usable area within one's brain through the increase of comprehension)!
51:48: 48. And We furnished the earth (energy lines - the nervous system of the body)... What excellent furnishers We are!
51:49: 49. And We created everything in pairs (positive - negative energy; the double stranded DNA)... That perhaps you will remember and contemplate.
51:50: 50. "Flee to Allah (from corporeality)! I am indeed a clear warner to you from Him!"
51:51: 51. "Do not assume a god besides Allah! Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him!"
51:52: 52. This is (the truth of the matter)! There came not to those before them a Rasul (calling them to Allah, their essential reality), except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
51:53: 53. Did they (genetically) suggest this to one another? No, they are a people in transgression!
51:54: 54. Turn away from them! You are not to be blamed (for this).
51:55: 55. And remind! Indeed, reminding benefits the believers.
51:56: 56. I have created the jinn and men only so that they may serve Me (by means of manifesting the qualities of My Names).
51:57: 57. I do not ask for provision from them; nor do I want them to feed Me.
51:58: 58. Indeed, Allah is HU, the Razzaq, the Dhu'l Quwwati'l Mateen (Possessor of Enduring Strength).
51:59: 59. Indeed, the wrongdoers will have their share of that (suffering) that befell their friends (those who came before them)! Let them not rush.
51:60: 60. Woe to those who deny the reality, from the suffering they are promised (forewarned)!
52:1: 1. By the Mount (Mount Sinai, on which Moses encountered the reality),
52:2: 2. And the inscribed knowledge (encompassing every detail)!
52:3: 3. In a parchment unrolled (manifested in the perceivable dimension of acts).
52:4: 4. And the prosperous house (the dimension of Names comprised of the knowledge pertaining to the Absolute Essence, the Reality of Muhammad, the perfectly constructed house - the human consciousness experiencing the quality of vicegerency generating from the Names of Allah);
52:5: 5. And the raised ceiling (the knowledge that surpasses the dimension of acts),
52:6: 6. And the overflowing ocean (waves of knowledge)!
52:7: 7. Indeed, the punishment of your Rabb will occur!
52:8: 8. There is no power to repel it!
52:9: 9. At that time, the heaven (consciousness) will be bewildered!
52:10: 10. And the mountains (egos) will depart! (Your Rabb is the Baqi!)
52:11: 11. Woe to those who deny that time!
52:12: 12. (Those deniers) who now amuse themselves with (worldly imaginary) indulgences!
52:13: 13. They will be relentlessly dragged into the Hellfire at that time!
52:14: 14. (And it will be said), "This is the Fire you denied!"
52:15: 15. "So is this magic then, or do you not see?"
52:16: 16. "Dwell in the Fire! Be patient or impatient; it makes no difference for you! You are living the consequences of your deeds!"
52:17: 17. Indeed, the protected ones are in Paradises and among blessings.
52:18: 18. They rejoice with what their Rabb manifests through them! Their Rabb (the Names comprising their being) has protected them from the suffering of Hell.
52:19: 19. "Eat and drink the results of your deeds with pleasure!"
52:20: 20. Resting on couches arranged in rows... We partnered them (the conscious humans manifesting the forces of the Names) with houris (bodies with superior and clear vision [heart])! (All expressions in the Quran of female houris are symbolic, allegoric expressions, like other metaphors pertaining to the life of Paradise. The statement 'Math'alul jannatillatiy' contained in various verses, which means, "The example [metaphor] of Paradise" [13:35] or "The allegoric description [metaphoric representation] of Paradise" [47:15] are indications of this truth. [Note that there is also a Hadith which states, "Allah says, 'I have prepared for My righteous servants things which no eye has ever seen, and no ear has ever heard, and no human heart/mind has ever perceived!'" Sahih Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi])
52:21: 21. Those who believe and whose descendants followed in faith, We shall unite them with their descendants and ascendants. And We did not detract anything from what they earned... Every person is bound by the consequences of his own deeds!
52:22: 22. We provided them abundantly with fruits (of gnosis) and meat (bodily qualities with which to manifest these qualities) as they desire.
52:23: 23. They will share cups of drinks therein, which does not cause intoxication!
52:24: 24. Youthful servants (energetic forces) will circulate around them, like they are hidden pearls!
52:25: 25. And they will turn to each other and discuss their previous states.
52:26: 26. They will say, "Indeed, previously we were the terrified ones among our people."
52:27: 27. "So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the suffering of the (Hellfire; the state of burning) samum (an infusing microwave radiation)!"
52:28: 28. "Indeed, we used to turn to Him before this! Indeed, He is the Barr, the Rahim."
52:29: 29. So, remind (my Rasul)! By the favor of your Rabb, you have not been disclosed as a soothsayer or one that is possessed!
52:30: 30. Or do they say, "He is a poet... Let us wait and see how his end will be"!
52:31: 31. Say, "Then wait! Indeed, I too am of those who are waiting!"
52:32: 32. Is it their minds that suggest this to them or are they an insolent people?
52:33: 33. Or do they say, "He has made it up"? No, they do not believe!
52:34: 34. If they are true to their word, let them bring a word like it!
52:35: 35. Or were they created without a cause? Or are they the creators?
52:36: 36. Or did they create the heavens and the earth? No, they are not certain.
52:37: 37. Or are the treasures of your Rabb with them? Or are they the rulers over all things?
52:38: 38. Or do they have a staircase upon which they climb and listen (to the divine mysteries)? (If that is the case) then let them bring a clear and undeniable proof.
52:39: 39. Or are the daughters His and the sons yours?
52:40: 40. Or do you ask of them a payment by which they are heavily indebted?
52:41: 41. Or do they have (knowledge of) the unknown; is it them who determines (what is to transpire)?
52:42: 42. Or do they intend to plan a trap? Yet they, who deny the knowledge of the reality, are the very ones who are entrapped!
52:43: 43. Or do they have gods besides Allah? Allah is Subhan from what they associate with Him!
52:44: 44. If they see an object falling from the sky, they will say, "It is but layers of clouds."
52:45: 45. Leave them until they meet the day (death) in which they will be struck by horror!
52:46: 46. That day, neither their traps will repel anything from them nor will there be anyone to help them!
52:47: 47. Indeed, for the wrongdoers there is a suffering before that too! But the majority of them do not know.
52:48: 48. Be patient for the command of your Rabb! Indeed, you are under Our supervision! And glorify (tasbih) your Rabb as His Hamd, when you get up (during the night)...
52:49: 49. And glorify (tasbih) your Rabb (as His Hamd) in a part of the night and after the setting of the stars!
53:1: 1. By the star (Najm) (that describes all of the reality by disclosing it part by part),
53:2: 2. Your friend has neither strayed nor has he erred!
53:3: 3. Nor does he speak from his own inclinations (imagination)!
53:4: 4. It is only a revealed revelation!
53:5: 5. Taught to him by one whose forces are intense!
53:6: 6. That (force) became apparent to him and thus he became open (to receiving revelation)!
53:7: 7. While he was at the highest point of the horizon (covering all of externality)!
53:8: 8. The he approached and descended (externality transformed into internality).
53:9: 9. And was (as close as) the distance between two bow lengths or nearer!
53:10: 10. Thus He revealed to His servant what He revealed.
53:11: 11. The heart did not lie about what it saw (the incoming information coalesced with the Truth revealed within the brain by the heart neurons)!
53:12: 12. Do you argue with him regarding what he saw?
53:13: 13. And indeed, he saw Him again (became aware as the reality descended to his consciousness).
53:14: 14. In the presence of the Lote Tree (the experience of eternity as pure universal consciousness).
53:15: 15. Near it (the Lote Tree) is the Paradise of Mawa!
53:16: 16. When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered it (the light of the reality covered his being as he lost his sense of being a body)!
53:17: 17. His sight neither wavered (to the concept of an 'other') nor did it transgress its limit (the observation of the reality did not lead him to become Pharaoh-like and deify himself)!
53:18: 18. Indeed, he saw the greatest signs of His Rabb (the Names comprising his essence)!
53:19: 19. Did you see the Lat and the Uzza?
53:20: 20. And Manat, the third (can they make you experience such an ascension)?
53:21: 21. Is the male yours and the female His?
53:22: 22. If so, that is an unjust division!
53:23: 23. They are mere names that you and your forefathers gave, for which Allah has not disclosed any proof (baseless names that do not point to anything that actually exists)! They follow only assumption and the illusory desires of their ego (even though) the knowledge of the reality has indeed come to them from their Rabb (the reality of the Names comprising their essence).
53:24: 24. Or is there a rule that man shall have whatever he desires?
53:25: 25. Both the eternal life to come and the world are for (the manifestations of the Names of) Allah!
53:26: 26. And how many angels are there in the heavens whose intercession will not be of any avail, except for those to whom Allah allows, those for whom He wills and with whom He is pleased?
53:27: 27. Indeed, those who do not believe in their eternal life to come define the angels as females.
53:28: 28. But they have no knowledge (proof) thereof... They follow only unverifiable assumptions, and indeed, never can assumption reflect the Truth!
53:29: 29. So, turn away from those who turn their backs to our dhikr (to the reality We remind them) and who desire nothing but the pleasures of the world!
53:30: 30. This is the highest point of their knowledge (to live in and die in pursuit of worldly pleasures; they cannot think beyond this)! Indeed, your Rabb, HU, knows better who strays from His way! And HU knows better who is guided to the reality!
53:31: 31. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is for (the manifestation of the qualities denoted by the Names of) Allah! That is so He may recompense those who do bad deeds with the consequences of their actions and requite those who do good deeds with the best reward.
53:32: 32. They are those who refrain from major mistakes (duality, slander, murder, etc.) and immoralities (fornication, adultery, etc.) only committing small mistakes resulting from their human nature... Indeed, vast is the forgiveness of your Rabb! He knows you better as He comprises your being with His Names; when He produced you from the earth (your body) and while you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers! So, do not try to exonerate yourselves! He knows better who protects themselves (as their creator with His Names)!
53:33: 33. Did you see the one who turned away?
53:34: 34. Who gave little, then refrained (from giving)!
53:35: 35. Has he the knowledge of the unknown, so that he sees?
53:36: 36. Or was he not informed of the pages (knowledge - laws) of Moses?
53:37: 37. And the (pages of) Abraham, the faithful?
53:38: 38. No bearer of burdens (guilty one) can bear the burden (offence) of another!
53:39: 39. And man will only accrue the results (consequences) of his own deeds (what manifests through him; his thoughts and actions)!
53:40: 40. And the results of his efforts will soon be seen!
53:41: 41. Then he will live the full results (of his deeds)!
53:42: 42. Indeed, the end of all things is to your Rabb!
53:43: 43. Indeed, it is HU who makes one laugh and weep!
53:44: 44. Indeed, it is HU who causes death and gives life (resurrects one with knowledge and enlightenment)!
53:45: 45. Indeed, it is HU who creates the two sexes, male and female...
53:46: 46. From a drop of sperm ejected (into the womb - the Rahim)!
53:47: 47. And upon Him is the second creation (second life)!
53:48: 48. And indeed, it is HU who enriches and deprives.
53:49: 49. And indeed, it is HU who is the Rabb of Sirius (the star)!
53:50: 50. And indeed, it is HU who destroyed the former Aad.
53:52: 52. And before them the people of Noah... Indeed, they, yes they, were more unjust and worse in egocentric indulgences.
53:53: 53. And He overthrew the cities (the destroyed cities: Sodom and Gomorrah)!
53:54: 54. And thus covered them with their coverings (as the result of their deeds)!
53:55: 55. So which of the favors of your Rabb will you doubt now!
53:56: 56. This is a warner just like the previous warners!
53:58: 58. There is none to avert (the hardship of death) besides Allah.
53:59: 59. Do you find this (the commencement of an eternal life through death) to be strange?
53:60: 60. And you laugh rather than weeping!
53:62: 62. Prostrate (experience your nonexistence) in the sight of Allah (your essential reality with His Names) and continue your servitude. (This is a verse of prostration.)
54:1: 1. The Hour has neared and the Moon (Qamar) has split asunder!
54:2: 2. Yet when they see a miracle they turn away and say, "Ordinary magic"!
54:3: 3. They deny and follow their own baseless desires (all that is pleasing to their egos)! But every matter will be settled!
54:4: 4. Indeed, there has come to them news in which there is deterrence.
54:5: 5. Wisdom (erudite knowledge with an accurate explanation of the purpose)! Yet warning does not help (the intellectually incapacitated)!
54:6: 6. So, turn away from them! At that time when the Caller calls to the terrifying event...
54:7: 7. Their eyes will be cast down in terror, they will emerge from their graves (cocoons) as if they are locusts spreading about.
54:8: 8. Those who deny the knowledge of the reality will run to the Caller saying, "This is an intense day!"
