69:18: 18. And you will be brought forth that day with none of your secrets left concealed (fully exposed)!

69:20: 20. "Indeed, I knew I was going to meet the results of my deeds!"

69:23: 23. The resulting fruits of his deeds will be within his reach!

69:26: 26. "I wish I had never known what is my account (the consequences of my deeds)!"
69:27: 27. "I wish it ended (before it came to this point)!"

69:29: 29. "All my power is lost and gone."

69:34: 34. "Nor did he make any effort to feed the needy (he was stingy)!"

69:36: 36. "Nor any food for him except for pus."

69:38: 38. So I swear by what you see,
69:39: 39. And what you do not see!
69:40: 40. Indeed, it is the word of a generous Rasul.
69:41: 41. It is not the word of a poet... How limited is your faith!
69:42: 42. Nor is it the word of a soothsayer... How little you remember and think!
69:43: 43. It is a (detailed) disclosure from the Rabb of the worlds!
69:44: 44. Had he made it up and attributed it to Us;

69:46: 46. Then We would have cut his jugular vein (carotid artery)!

69:51: 51. Indeed, that (Doomsday period) is the (clear) experience of the Truth!

70:10: 10. And no friend will be in the state to call another!

71:9: 9. "Then I invited them publicly, and I also explained it to them in private."
71:10: 10. I said, "Ask forgiveness of your Rabb... Indeed, He is the Gaffar."

71:20: 20. "So that you may traverse therein, on spacious ways."

71:23: 23. They said, "Never leave your gods! Never leave Wadd, Suwa or Yaghuth and Yauq and Nasr (the names of their deities)!"
71:24: 24. "And thus they lead many astray... So, increase the wrongdoers in their error!"

71:26: 26. And Noah said, "My Rabb... Do not leave upon earth anyone from among those who deny the knowledge of the reality!"
71:27: 27. "For if you leave them, they will lead your servants astray and spawn no other than those who deny the knowledge of the reality and who disobey the commands (their genes will only reproduce their like!)."
71:28: 28. "My Rabb... Forgive me, my parents, the one who enters my house as a believer, the believing men and the believing women! And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction!"
72:1: 1. Say: "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened (to the Quran) and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Quran.'"
72:2: 2. "It guides to the right course (maturity/perfection), so we have believed in it. And we will never associate partners to our Rabb!"
72:3: 3. "Indeed, exalted is the nobleness of our Rabb; He has not taken a wife or a son!"
72:4: 4. "Our inadequate understanding has been making us claim foolish things about Allah!"
72:5: 5. "We had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak a lie about Allah."
72:6: 6. "And yet there were men and women from mankind who sought refuge in men and women from the jinn, thereby increasing (provoking each other) in excessive (carnal) behavior."
72:7: 7. "And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never resurrect (ba'th) anyone." (This verse indicates that jinn, like humans, have no proficiency pertaining to life after death/resurrection.)
72:8: 8. "And we touched the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards (forces) and burning flames (rays that impeded our judgment)."
72:9: 9. "And we used to take up positions therein to listen, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him."
72:10: 10. And we do not know whether evil is intended for those on earth (body) or whether their Rabb intends for them a right course (the maturity to observe the reality). (This verse is a clear proof that the jinn have no knowledge of how people will live; how their essential composition of Names will manifest in their lives and what their purpose of manifesting in the sight of Allah is.)
72:11: 11. "And among us are the righteous, and among us are those who are below (the righteous state); we are of various ways (different breeds/species/races; a cosmopolitan community of different make-up and understanding)."
72:12: 12. "And we have become certain that we can never invalidate Allah's command upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight."
72:13: 13. "When we heard the guidance (Quran), we believed it was the reality. And whoever believes in his Rabb as his own reality, will not fear any deprivation (of his rights) or derogation."
72:14: 14. "And among us are those in submission, and among us are wrongdoers who rebel against the commands. And those who submit are the aspirants of the fullness of the reality."
72:15: 15. "But as for the wrongdoers who disobey the commands, they will be firewood for Hell!"
72:16: 16. If they had walked upon the path (to their reality), surely We would have watered them with the water (of knowledge and gnosis).
72:17: 17. We would have tried them with it, to reveal their true nature. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Rabb, He will subject him to an increasing suffering!
72:18: 18. Indeed, the places of prostration are for Allah. So do not (while in the state of prostration) turn to things besides Allah!
72:19: 19. Whenever Abdullah (the servant of Allah - Muhammad [saw]) stands to turn to Him, they crowd around and stifle him!
72:20: 20. Say, "I turn only to (and ask only from) my Rabb! Never will I associate others to He who comprises my essence!"
72:21: 21. Say, "I can neither give you harm nor form the maturity in you to experience the reality (these are things for Allah to manifest through you)!"
72:22: 22. Say, "For none can save me from Allah and there is no place of refuge besides Him!"
72:23: 23. Except for what Allah reveals and His risalahs (the knowledge He discloses through His Rasuls)! So, whoever disobeys Allah and His Rasul, for him there is Fire in which he will abide forever!
72:24: 24. But when they see the thing that they have been promised (death), they will understand who the minority and the helpless are!
72:25: 25. Say, "I do not know whether what you have been promised is near or whether my Rabb has set for it a long period."
72:26: 26. He knows the unknown! And He does not disclose His Unknown (Absolute Essence) to anyone;
72:27: 27. Except for a chosen-purified Rasul! And indeed, He places guards in front and behind him (the Rasul)!
72:28: 28. That they may know that they have conveyed the disclosed knowledge of their Rabb. He has encompassed whatever is with them and recorded everything in detail!
73:2: 2. Arise in the night, except for a little;

73:11: 11. Leave me (to deal alone) with those who deny in their abundance! Give them respite.
73:12: 12. Indeed, there are chains and Hellfire with us. Note: Imam Razi, a renowned interpreter of the Quran, says the following about the symbolism used in regards to the suffering of Hell: "These four states may be seen as the spiritual results of what the person did in his life. 'Heavy irons' is symbolic of his former material interests and the continuation of his imprisonment to his bodily pleasures. The day when they are no longer able to actualize these irons and chains become the means to prevent the resurrected person (ego) from reaching the stations of sublimity and purity. Thereafter, these spiritual irons bring about 'spiritual fire', for when the person feels a strong desire for a bodily pleasure and is unable to attain it, a sense of severe burning takes place within his being. This is the meaning of the 'burning hellfire'. The sinner, in this state, feels in his throat the pain of separation from the things he desires and the suffocating sensation of being deprived of them. This is the meaning of the expression 'food that gets stuck in their throats'. And finally, because of being in this state, he is bereft of the company of those who are enlightened with the Nur of Allah and sanctified, thus the meaning of 'severe suffering'. But know that I am not asserting that the meaning of these Quranic expressions are confined only to what I say..."
73:13: 13. And food that gets stuck in their throats and a severe suffering!
73:14: 14. At that time the earth (body) and the mountains (ego-identities) will be shaken... And the mountains will become a heap of dust!
73:15: 15. Indeed, just as We disclosed a Rasul (guider to the reality, purifier) to Pharaoh, We have also sent a Rasul to you as a witness.
73:16: 16. Pharaoh disobeyed that Rasul and We seized him with a destructive seizure!
73:17: 17. If you are ungrateful (to the disclosed reality), how will you be protected at that time which will make the children grey-haired and old?
73:18: 18. The heaven will split apart there from; His promise is fulfilled!
73:19: 19. Indeed, this is a reminder! So whoever wills may take the way (that leads) to his Rabb!
73:20: 20. Your Rabb knows that you arise in two-thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and so do a group of those with you. And it is Allah who determines the night and the day! (Allah) knows you will never be able to evaluate it and accepted your repentance... So, recite (comprehend) what is easy for you of the Quran! (Allah) knows that there will be among you those who are ill, and those who travel throughout the land seeking the bounty of Allah, and those who fight in the way of Allah. So, recite what is easy from it and establish salat (maintain your turning with observation), give alms and give a good loan to Allah... Whatever good you give for yourself you will find it much greater and better in the sight of Allah. Ask forgiveness of Allah! Indeed, Allah is the Ghafur, the Rahim.
74:3: 3. Realize the magnificence of your Rabb!
74:6: 6. And do not engage in good to acquire more (with greed)!
74:8: 8. When that trumpet is blown (death, resurrection);
74:9: 9. It will be a difficult time, indeed!
74:10: 10. Not easy at all for those who deny (cover) the knowledge of the reality!
74:11: 11. So leave me (to deal) with the one I created alone;
74:12: 12. The one whom I granted wealth;
74:14: 14. And enabled the experience of expansive abundance!
74:15: 15. Yet he (greedily) wants me to increase it for him!

74:17: 17. I will subject him to an arduous uphill climb.
74:19: 19. May he die (and see the reality)! How he decided!
74:20: 20. Again, may he die (and see the reality)! How he decided!
74:23: 23. Then he turned his back and became arrogant!
74:24: 24. And he said, "This is nothing other than narrated words of magic!"
74:25: 25. "It is no other than the words of a mortal!"
74:26: 26. I will subject him to Saqar (painful tormenting fire).
74:27: 27. And what informs you of Saqar?
74:28: 28. (Saqar) neither lets anything remain the same, nor does it let anything be!
74:29: 29. It burns and blackens the (flesh of) mortals!
74:31: 31. We have appointed only (nineteen) angels (66:6) to be the wardens of the Fire (the hell of corporeality; not a breed of humans or the jinn)... And We specified their number (as if the number nineteen is meaningful) as an (object of) trial for the disbelievers... So, those to whom a Book (knowledge) has been given can know with certainty (what is referenced by these metaphors and thus confirm the revelation of Rasulullah [saw]) and so those who believe (in the nubuwwah and risalah of Rasulullah [saw]) will increase in faith (the knowledge of certainty; ilm al-yakeen) and so those (who acquire solid knowledge) to whom a Book (knowledge) has been given (and those who have attained certainty in faith) do not fall into doubt! And so those in whose hearts there is sickness (doubt, who are devoid of healthy thought) and the disbelievers (who are veiled from and thus deny the reality) can say, "What did Allah intend to reference with this example?"... Thus Allah misguides whom He wills and guides whom He wills. Only HU knows the armies (forces) of your Rabb! This (Saqar and other metaphors) is only a reminder for people.
74:32: 32. No! I swear by the Moon,
74:33: 33. And the night, when it returns,
74:34: 34. And the morning, when it brightens.
74:35: 35. Indeed, it is one of the greatest things!
74:37: 37. For whoever wants to go forward or stay behind.
74:38: 38. Everyone is bound by the results of their own deeds!
74:39: 39. Except for the people of the right!
74:40: 40. They are in Paradises... They ask,
74:42: 42. "What has let you into the Saqar (the entwining fire with immense flames)?"

74:45: 45. "And we indulged (in egotistic pleasures) with those who indulged!"
74:46: 46. "And we denied the time of religion (sunnatullah - that recompense will definitely be experienced for all actions)!"
74:47: 47. "Until finally there came to us certainty (confrontation of the reality)!"
74:48: 48. Then the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them.
74:49: 49. What is the matter them that they turn away from the one who reminds them?
74:50: 50. They are like wild donkeys running about in fear!
74:51: 51. As though fleeing in fear from a lion!
74:52: 52. Perhaps each one of them desires to be given pages (of revelation)!
74:53: 53. No! They do not fear the eternal life to come!
74:54: 54. No! Indeed, it is but a reminder!
74:55: 55. Whoever wills will remember (and evaluate) it!
74:56: 56. And they cannot remember (and evaluate) unless Allah wills... He enables protection to whom He wills and forgives whom He wills.
75:1: 1. By the reality of the Doomsday;
75:3: 3. Does man think We will not assemble his bones?
75:4: 4. Indeed! We even have the power to proportion his fingertips (produce a precise reformation of his fingerprints)!
75:5: 5. But no! Man goes to excess despite what awaits him (life after death)!
75:6: 6. They ask, "When is the time of Doomsday (the experience of death)?

75:12: 12. At that time, the permanent settlement (of every individual) is with his Rabb!

75:15: 15. Whatever excuse he presents (it will make no difference)!
75:16: 16. Do not repeat it with your tongue to hasten (its memorization).
75:17: 17. Indeed, upon Us is its compilation and its recitation.
75:18: 18. So when We recite it, follow its recitation!
75:19: 19. Then upon Us is its clarification (disclosure).

75:21: 21. And leave the eternal life to come!

75:40: 40. Is this (the system and order of Allah who made all of this) not Qadir to give life to the dead?

90:2: 2. That you are free of restriction herein!
90:3: 3. And (I swear) by the One who gives birth (to man) and that which is born of him,
90:4: 4. We have certainly created man in stages of difficulty!
90:5: 5. Does he now think that none can overpower him?
90:6: 6. He says, "I have spent much wealth."
90:7: 7. Does he think nobody can see him?
90:8: 8. Did We not form two eyes for him?
90:10: 10. And showed him the two ways (of falsity and Truth)!
90:11: 11. But he did not have (the courage) to climb that steep hill!
90:12: 12. Do you know what that steep hill is?
90:13: 13. It is to liberate from slavery (to free consciousness from its enslavement to the body)!
90:14: 14. Or to feed another while hungry!
90:15: 15. (To feed) an orphan of near relation.
90:16: 16. Or to feed the impoverished one who is in distress.
90:17: 17. And then to be of those who believe and advise patience and mercy to one another.
90:18: 18. These are the people of the right (the fortunate ones).
90:19: 19. But those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left (the unfortunate ones).
90:20: 20. They are enclosed and trapped in Fire!
91:1: 1. By the Sun and its light (the time the sun starts to illuminate the earth);
91:2: 2. And by the Moon when it follows it,
91:3: 3. And by the day that reveals it,
91:4: 4. And by the night that covers it,
91:5: 5. And by the heaven and the One who constructed it,
91:6: 6. And by the earth and the One who spread it,
91:7: 7. By the self (the individual consciousness; identity) and the One who proportioned it (formed the brain);
91:8: 8. Then inspired it as to what will lead it astray from the Truth and the system, and how to protect itself...
91:9: 9. He who purifies (his consciousness) has succeeded.
91:10: 10. And he who buries and hides (his consciousness by pursuing unconscious impulses) has lost.
91:11: 11. Thamud (the people of Salih) denied (their reality and the system) by refusing the Nabi.
91:12: 12. When the most unfortunate of them rose up,
91:13: 13. The Rasul of Allah said, "Protect the she-camel of Allah, and her right to drink!"
91:14: 14. But they denied (the Rasul of Allah) and savagely killed her (the she-camel). So their Rabb destroyed them for their sins and leveled their city to the ground.
91:15: 15. The consequence of this does not frighten Allah!
92:1: 1. I swear by the night when it covers over,
92:2: 2. And by the day as it radiantly appears,
92:3: 3. And by the One who created the male and the female (active and receptive energies),
92:4: 4. Indeed, your efforts are of different intentions.
92:5: 5. He who gives (both of himself, i.e. his constructed identity, and from himself, i.e. from that which is valuable for him) and protects himself,
92:6: 6. And believes in (confirms) the Most Beautiful (Names) (to be his essential reality),
92:7: 7. We will ease him towards ease.
92:8: 8. But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need (for purification and protection),
92:9: 9. And denies the Most Beautiful (to be his essential reality),
92:10: 10. We will ease him toward the most difficult (to a life veiled from the knowledge of the reality and the sunnatullah)!
92:11: 11. And when he falls (into Hell) his wealth will be of no avail to him.
92:12: 12. Upon Us is guidance to the reality.
92:13: 13. And indeed, to Us belongs the eternal life to come and the present one!
92:14: 14. I have warned you of a blazing Fire.
92:15: 15. Only the most unfortunate will be subjected to it.
92:16: 16. Who had denied and turned away (from his essence)!
92:17: 17. But the one who sought protection will be kept away from it.
92:18: 18. The one who spends his wealth on others to become purified (rather than hoarding),
92:19: 19. And he does this not for a return (nor as the return for anything)!
92:20: 20. Only for the sake of the countenance of his Rabb, the Most High!
92:21: 21. And indeed, he will be pleased!
93:1: 1. I swear by the morning light (when the sun starts to illuminate the earth; ad-Dhuha),
93:2: 2. And by the night, the time of tranquility.
93:3: 3. Your Rabb has not forsaken you nor is He displeased with you!
93:4: 4. Surely, the eternal life to come is better for you than the present one.
93:5: 5. Your Rabb is going to give to you and you are going to be well pleased!
93:6: 6. Did He not find you an orphan and gave you refuge?
93:7: 7. Did He not find you lost (unaware of your essential reality) and guided you to the reality?
93:8: 8. And did We not find you poor (faqr, in nothingness) and made you rich (with infinity - baqa, i.e.)? (Did we not make you a servant of the Ghani? Did we not enrich and emancipate you?)
93:9: 9. So, do not look down on the orphan,
93:10: 10. And do not scold the one who inquires and wants!
93:11: 11. Express the blessings of your Rabb!
94:1: 1. Did We not expand your breast (broaden your capabilities)?
94:2: 2. Did We not remove your burden (of your identity) from you (by revealing the reality to you)?
94:3: 3. Which had weighed (heavy) upon your back (overburdened you)!
94:4: 4. Did We not exalt your remembrance (by reminding you of and making you live by the reality)?
94:5: 5. So, surely with every hardship there is ease.
94:6: 6. Yes, surely with every hardship there is ease.
94:7: 7. So, when you are free (of your duties) labor (for your actual duty)!
95:1: 1. By the fig and the olive,
95:4: 4. We have certainly created man in the best of forms (with the qualities of the Names).
95:5: 5. Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low (to his world of conditionings).
95:6: 6. Except for those who believe (in their essential reality) and fulfill the requisites of faith! For them there is an uninterrupted reward!
95:7: 7. So what can cause you to deny the religion after this (when the reality and the sunnatullah are so evidently observable)?
95:8: 8. Is Allah not the judge of all judges?
96:1: 1. READ with the Name of your Rabb (with the knowledge that comprises your being) who created.
96:2: 2. Created man from alaq (a clot of blood; genetic composition).
96:3: 3. READ! For your Rabb is Akram (most generous).
96:4: 4. Who taught (programmed the genes and the essential qualities) by the Pen.
96:5: 5. Taught man that which he knew not.
96:6: 6. No (it is not like what they think)! Indeed, man transgresses (pursues and indulges in his desires when he lives cocooned from his essence);
96:7: 7. Because he sees himself as self-sufficient (the veil of his ego makes him think he is not in need of the reality).
96:8: 8. Indeed, to your Rabb is the return!
96:9: 9. Did you see the one who prevents,
96:11: 11. Did you see (have a think)! What if he is living the reality?
96:13: 13. Have a think! What if he denied (his essence) and turned away?
96:14: 14. Does he not know that Allah sees?
96:15: 15. No (it is not like what they think)! Indeed, if he does not desist, We will drag him by his forehead (brain)!
96:16: 16. A lying, mistaken (driven by corporeality) forehead (brain)!
96:17: 17. Then let him call his council!
96:18: 18. And We shall call the keepers of Hell (the degenerating forces of Fire)!
96:19: 19. No, do not! Do not obey him! Prostrate and draw near! (This is a verse of prostration.)
97:1: 1. Indeed, We disclosed it (the Quran) during the Night of Power (of Muhammad [saw])!
97:2: 2. Do you know (the value, honor, magnificence of) the Night of Power?
97:3: 3. The Night of Power is better than a thousand months (a lifetime of 80 years).
97:4: 4. The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Rabb (Name composition) for every matter (that has manifested as Allah's decree).
97:5: 5. Salam (the experience of the essence) it is until the emergence of dawn (until the consciousness recognizes the disclosure of the reality).
98:1: 1. Those deniers of the reality, from among the people of the book and the dualists, were not to part (from their excessive ways) until there came to them clear evidence.
98:2: 2. A Rasul from Allah, informing them of the pure pages (knowledge pertaining to the reality, which those who are not purified from the filth of duality cannot touch).
98:3: 3. Within which are solid books (solid - substantial - reliable information).
98:4: 4. But those to whom a Book was given fell into diversion after the clear evidence had come to them.
98:5: 5. Whereas they were not commanded with anything other than to serve Allah by devoting their faith to Him as a Hanif (without the concept of a deity; with the consciousness of being in servitude to Allah alone), to establish salat and to give alms... This is the (valid) religion (system)!
98:6: 6. Indeed, those who deny the knowledge of the reality, from among the people of the book and the dualists, are in the Fire, to abide therein eternally! They are the most evil of the people!
98:7: 7. As for those who believe and fulfill the requisites of faith, they are the best of people!
98:8: 8. The respite of their deeds in the sight of their Rabb is Paradises of Eden, underneath which rivers flow, to abide therein eternally... Well-pleased is Allah with them, and well-pleased are they with Him (the reflections of divine qualities)... This is for he who is in awe of his Rabb!
99:1: 1. When the earth (the body) is shaken with an intense quake,
99:2: 2. And the earth discharges its burdens,
99:3: 3. And man (consciousness panics and) asks, "What is wrong with it (the body)?"
99:4: 4. That is the time it will report its news,
99:5: 5. With a revelation from your Rabb.
99:6: 6. That day the people will go forth in groups to see the results of their deeds!
99:7: 7. Whoever does an iota's weight of good will see it,
99:8: 8. And whoever does an iota's weight of evil will see it.
100:1: 1. By the racers (people who are like wild horses), panting (to collect worldly wealth),
100:2: 2. Striking sparks of fire (out of their greed and anger),
100:3: 3. And rising at dawn to make raids,
100:4: 4. Who stir up clouds of dust with their greed,
100:5: 5. And push and hustle their way among the people in that state... (woe to them)!
100:6: 6. Indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Rabb!
100:7: 7. And to this he bears witness!
100:8: 8. Indeed, he has an intense desire for wealth!
100:9: 9. Does he not know when that which is in the grave (the body) is dredged up and taken out,
100:10: 10. And that which is in the hearts is made manifest,
100:11: 11. That their Rabb, as the Names comprising their essence, is ever knowing (Habir) of them.
101:2: 2. What a dreadful event, the Qaria!
101:3: 3. Do you know what the Qaria is?
101:4: 4. It is the time when the people will be like moths (propelling towards the fire).
101:5: 5. And the mountains (egos) like colorful soft wool (depleted and weak)!
101:6: 6. So the results of whomever weigh heavy (at that time),
101:7: 7. He will be in a life well-pleasing!
101:8: 8. And the results of whomever weigh light,
101:9: 9. His mother (abode) will be an abyss.
101:10: 10. Do you know what that is?
101:11: 11. It is a fire that scorches at maximum intensity!
102:1: 1. Greed (for wealth and offspring) deceived and amused you!
102:2: 2. Even when you visited the graves...
102:3: 3. But no! Soon (with death) you will know.
102:4: 4. Again no! Soon you will know.
102:5: 5. No! If only you had established your certainty through knowledge (before death)...
102:6: 6. Indeed, you will definitely see the Hell!
102:7: 7. Indeed, you will most certainly see it (Hell) with the eye of certainty.
102:8: 8. Then indeed, at that time you will be asked about your blessings.
103:1: 1. By that time (the life span of man),
103:3: 3. Except for those who have believed (in their essential reality) and fulfilled the requisites of faith, advised each other of the Truth and advised each other to patience!
104:1: 1. Woe to every gossiper and abusive reprobate!
104:2: 2. Who collects wealth and counts it and recounts it (constantly checking his bank account to see how much money he has)!
104:3: 3. Thinking his wealth will make him immortal!
104:4: 4. No, (it is not like what he thinks)! Indeed, he will surely be thrown into the Crusher (the crushing torment).
104:5: 5. And what informs you of the Crusher?
104:6: 6. It is the inflamed fire of Allah (ignited in the mind, deriving from his nature)!
104:7: 7. Covering the hearts (the reflectors of the Names to consciousness).
104:8: 8. Indeed, it closes in on them (they are eternally trapped in it),
105:1: 1. Did you not see how your Rabb dealt with the people of the elephant?
105:2: 2. Did He not make their plan worthless?
105:3: 3. And disclosed upon them the birds in flocks (the Common Swift),
105:4: 4. Who threw upon them stones of hard clay,
105:5: 5. Until they became like eaten straw.
106:1: 1. In order to establish acquaintenceship and respect for the Quraysh,
106:2: 2. For the safety and comfort of their winter and summer journeys.
106:3: 3. Let them serve the Rabb of this city (as those who acknowledge the Truth of non-duality)!
106:4: 4. Who fed them (saving them from hunger) and secured them from fear.
107:1: 1. Did you see the one who denies his religion (the sunnatullah)?
107:2: 2. Who scolds the orphan - pushing and shoving him,
107:3: 3. And who does not encourage feeding the needy (stingy, selfish)!
107:4: 4. So, woe to those who pray (out of custom),
107:5: 5. Who are heedless (cocooned) of (the experience of the meaning of) their salat (which is an ascension [miraj] to their innermost essential reality; their Rabb).
107:6: 6. They are the ones who make a show of their deeds,
108:1: 1. Indeed, We gave you the Kawthar!
108:2: 2. So, experience salat for your Rabb and sacrifice (your ego)!
108:3: 3. Indeed, it is the one who resents you that is cut off (whose progeny has been made discontinuous)!
109:1: 1. Say, "O those who deny the knowledge of the reality!"
109:2: 2. "I do not deify that which you deify (your Inciting Self [ego]- the second brain in your gut)."
109:3: 3. "Nor are you worshippers of (in servitude to) what I worship."
109:4: 4. "Nor will I worship (serve) that which you deify."
109:5: 5. Nor will you worship (serve) what I serve."
109:6: 6. "For you is your (understanding of) religion and for me is (my understanding of) religion!"
110:2: 2. And you see the people entering the religion of Allah in masses,
110:3: 3. Glorify (tasbih) your Rabb as his Hamd and ask forgiveness of Him! Indeed, He is the Tawwab.
111:1: 1. May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined... And ruined he is!
111:2: 2. Neither his wealth nor his earnings availed him!
111:3: 3. He will be subject to a blazing Fire!
111:4: 4. His wife as well... As a wood-carrier!
111:5: 5. With a rope of palm-fiber around her neck!
112:1: 1. Say: "Allah is Ahad (One)." (Allah is the infinite, limitless and indivisible, non-dual ONENESS.)
112:2: 2. "Allah is Samad." (Absolute Self-Sufficient One beyond any need or defect, free from the concept of multiplicity, and far from conceptualization and limitation. The one into whom nothing can enter, and the One from whom no other form of existence can come out!)
112:3: 3. "He begets not. (No other form of existence has ever originated from Him, thus, there is no other.) Nor was He begotten." (There is no other god or form of existence from which He could have originated.)
112:4: 4. "There is none like unto Him!" (Nothing - no conception - in the micro or macro planes of existence is equivalent to or in resemblance of Him.)
113:1: 1. Say (recognize, realize, comprehend, experience): "I seek refuge in the Rabb (the reality of the Names comprising my essence) of the Falaq (the light that prevails over the darkness and brings enlightenment to me)."
113:3: 3. "From the evil of the darkness that settles in my mind preventing me from perceiving and comprehending..."
113:4: 4. "From the evil of the women who blow on knots (those who manipulate brain waves to make black magic)."
113:5: 5. "And from the evil eye of the envier when he envies!"
114:1: 1. Say (recognize, realize, comprehend, experience): "I seek refuge in the Rabb (the reality of the Names comprising the essence) of the Nas (mankind)."
114:2: 2. "The Sovereign of man," (The Malik, the One whose sovereignty and administration is absolute over Nas, mankind.)
114:3: 3. "The God of man," (The reality of Uluhiyya that resides within the essence of every human, with which he subsists his existence, and mistakenly thinks this state pertains to a god outside of himself!)
114:4: 4. "From the evil of the whisperer that covertly pervades then retreats, and reduces man to corporeality."
114:5: 5. "That which whispers illusory thoughts into man's consciousness about man's essential reality."
114:6: 6. "From among the jinni (invisible forces) and man!"
